title: Approval
description: The approval state the host holds for one chat: Ask me (manual) or Auto within limits (auto), and the one grant an explicit user decision minted. A grant admits one host action on one resource revision (a pack update, a Dialect publication) within fifteen minutes, is consumed by the commit, and is never minted by model output. No approval crosses the engine slot today: the run proposes and ends, and the host acts on the proposal afterwards under this state; a model's request for more compute is a budget_paused event and the person's grant is a checkpoint grant (checkpoint.json); a question for the person is user_question. Read from ActionApproval and ActionGrant (web/src/assistant/approvals/client.ts) and the server's assistantActionGrant (internal/desk/assistant_approval.go). Open: the chat reads the answer by a cast, with no check.

mode.description: manual unless a ready grant exists.

target.description: The chat action the grant is for, where the action names one (a Dialect publication).

action.description: The host action admitted. The chat's controls name pack-update and dialect-publish.

revision.description: The resource revision the grant is bound to; a change invalidates it.

expiresAt.description: An RFC 3339 time, fifteen minutes after the grant.

request.description: What the chat posts to grant, revoke or commit (assistantApprovalRequest). Closed: the server decodes it with unknown and duplicate members refused.
